_comment: SHIP-PARITY REGISTER. Declared deviations from shipped render config in perf harnesses, keyed file|property|rhs (NOT line - lines move). THIS LIST ONLY SHRINKS. 'count' and 'ceiling' are the ratchet's witnesses: the probe FAILS if either disagrees with 'deviations', so a hand-edit cannot pass quietly. --write-baseline can only ever remove entries. New entries enter ONLY via --grandfather --reason=<text>. A declaration NEVER satisfies RULE B: a harness that deviates must still restore ship somewhere, and no register entry can buy its way out of that.

grandfather_log.reason: Legitimate study phases, not baselines: perf_probe --shadow-study prices the atmosphere cost of a shadow the game does not ship (40m/80m/uncapped), and arena_perf_overlay F6 is the interactive equivalent. Both restore ship on their default arm, which RULE B verifies independently of this register.
